settings.name: ENROLMENT_ISSUER
settings.description: This service's entity id: the attestations' iss and the key proofs' aud

when_wrong.detail: Unset: the service does not start, naming it

settings.name: PORT
settings.description: The port the service listens on

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number, or not a port: the service does not start

settings.name: REGISTRY
settings.description: Where enrolments live: iom, the Identity Object Model directory, or memory, this process only, lost on restart, with a warning

when_wrong.detail: Not iom or memory (any case): the service does not start, naming it. memory under the production profile without in-memory-state in OIDF_ACCEPTED_RISKS: the service does not start (exit status 1), listing it

settings.name: IDM_DATABASE_URL
settings.description: The Identity Object Model directory (Postgres) the registry lives in, as a JDBC URL or a postgresql:// DSN; not read with REGISTRY=memory. It wins over DATABASE_URL, which is never used

when_wrong.detail: Unset: the service does not start, naming it; a URL that is neither jdbc:postgresql: nor postgres(ql)://, a jdbc: URL for another database included, is refused, naming only its scheme

settings.name: DATABASE_URL
settings.description: Read only to refuse it: the registry's database before it moved to the Identity Object Model. Set while IDM_DATABASE_URL is unset, the service does not start and names the rename; with IDM_DATABASE_URL set it is ignored

when_wrong.detail: Set without IDM_DATABASE_URL: the service does not start, naming IDM_DATABASE_URL

settings.name: ENROLMENT_SIGNING_JWK
settings.description: The attester's private JWK, as JSON

when_wrong.detail: Unset or not a JSON JWK: the service does not start, naming it

settings.name: APPLE_TEAM_ID
settings.description: The Apple team of the App ID an App Attest attestation must be bound to; with the bundle id, App Attest is on

when_wrong.detail: Set without APPLE_BUNDLE_ID: the service does not start, naming both

settings.name: APPLE_BUNDLE_ID
settings.description: The bundle of the App ID an App Attest attestation must be bound to

when_wrong.detail: Set without APPLE_TEAM_ID: the service does not start, naming both

settings.name: APPLE_ALLOW_DEVELOPMENT
settings.description: Whether development App Attest objects are accepted, each flagged in the registry, with a warning; true is forbidden under the production profile, which stops the service at start-up

when_wrong.detail: true under the production profile: the service does not start (exit status 1), listing it. Not true or false (any case): the service does not start, naming it; under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false with a warning

settings.name: APPLE_MACOS_REQUIRE_KEY_POLICY
settings.description: Whether a Mac's App Attest key must show Full Security and SIP

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false (any case): the service does not start, naming it; under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false with a warning

settings.name: APPLE_REQUIRE_RENEWAL_ASSERTION
settings.description: Whether an App Attest enrolment renews with an app_attest_assertion

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false (any case): the service does not start, naming it; under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false with a warning

settings.name: CONNECTOR_BUILDS
settings.description: The connector builds accepted, as base64url SHA-256 hashes, comma-separated; unset accepts any build and records it

when_wrong.detail: Taken as written: a wrong hash refuses that build

settings.name: UV_MAX_AGE_SECONDS
settings.description: The oldest a user verification may be at binding; must match the instance-registry-datasource's field

when_wrong.detail: Not a whole number: the service does not start, naming it; under development a padded number is read with a warning

settings.name: REQUIRE_COMPLIANT_DEVICE
settings.description: Whether a device whose compliance is unknown is refused an attestation; false is forbidden under the production profile, which stops the service at start-up

when_wrong.detail: false under the production profile: the service does not start (exit status 1), listing it. Not true or false (any case): the service does not start, naming it; under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false with a warning

settings.name: PINGONE_ISSUER
settings.description: The PingOne environment that authenticates the user; with the client id, user authentication is on

when_wrong.detail: Unset: every user authentication is refused, with a warning at start

settings.name: PINGONE_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: The PingOne client whose ID tokens are accepted

when_wrong.detail: Unset: every user authentication is refused, with a warning at start

settings.name: PINGONE_ACR_AAL2
settings.description: The sign-on policy names, comma-separated, whose acr means AAL2; anything else is AAL1 and refused for binding

when_wrong.detail: Empty: every authentication is AAL1 and refused for binding, with a warning at start

settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTATION_SUB
settings.description: client_id mints the attestation's sub as the registered client, with the instance id as agent_id; unset keeps the instance id as sub

when_wrong.detail: Anything but client_id (any case): the service does not start, naming it

settings.name: OIDF_AGENT_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: The registered client minted as sub when OIDF_ATTESTATION_SUB=client_id

when_wrong.detail: Unset with OIDF_ATTESTATION_SUB=client_id: the service does not start, naming it

settings.name: YUBICO_PIV_ROOTS
settings.description: A PEM bundle of pinned Yubico PIV roots; set, yubikey-piv evidence is accepted

when_wrong.detail: A file that cannot be read as PEM certificates: the service does not start

settings.name: ALLOW_SELF_ASSERTED_KEYS
settings.description: Whether secure-enclave-self-asserted evidence, a key whose storage nobody can verify, is attested (without a key_storage claim), with a warning

when_wrong.detail: Not true or false (any case): the service does not start, naming it; under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false with a warning

settings.name: AGENT_AUTHORIZATION_DETAILS
settings.description: A JSON array: the RFC 9396 ceiling every connector attestation carries

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON array of objects: the service does not start

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_ENTITY_ID
settings.description: The federation authority (PingFederate's issuer) that hosts agent entities; unset, none is registered

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: each enrolment's registration with the authority fails

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_URL
settings.description: Where to reach the authority from here; the entity id when unset

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL: the service does not start, naming it. Wrong: each enrolment's registration with the authority fails, and its credentials - a DPoP-bound token and proof, or in development the static bearer - go to whatever host it names

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN
settings.description: Development only: the authority's static bearer (OIDF_AUTHORITY_ADMIN_TOKEN there), sent when PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID is unset, with a WARN per enrolment. Production refuses to start with it set, as the authority refuses its static bearer there

when_wrong.detail: Set in production: the service does not start, naming it. Unset in development with the entity id and no PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID: the service does not start, naming the settings to set

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_INSECURE_TLS
settings.description: Trusts any certificate on the authority's listener, for development, through platform's InsecureTls; the host name is still checked

when_wrong.detail: true under the production profile: the service does not start (exit status 1), listing it. Not true or false (any case): the service does not start, naming it; under development yes, no, 1, 0, on and off are read as false with a warning

settings.name: AGENT_DISPLAY_NAME
settings.description: The display name the authority vouches for about every agent

when_wrong.detail: Taken as written

settings.name: AGENT_DESCRIPTION
settings.description: The description the authority vouches for about every agent

when_wrong.detail: Taken as written

settings.name: AGENT_KEYWORDS
settings.description: A JSON array of strings: the keywords the authority vouches for about every agent

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON array of strings: the service does not start

settings.name: AGENT_MISSION_TYPES
settings.description: A JSON array: the RAR types an agent may claim, an essential subset_of in the authority's statement

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON array of strings: the service does not start

settings.name: AGENT_MISSION_PURPOSES
settings.description: A JSON array: the DPV purposes an agent may pursue, an essential subset_of in the authority's statement

when_wrong.detail: Not a JSON array of strings: the service does not start

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID
settings.description: device-enrolment's client at the authority's PingFederate: it gets an access token by client credentials with the scope oidf.admin.entities, each token request carrying a DPoP proof, and enrols agents with it under the DPoP scheme. Set it with exactly one of PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_JWK and PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_SECRET; in PingFederate the client needs the client credentials grant, the oidf.admin.entities scope and Require DPoP

when_wrong.detail: Set without exactly one of the key and the secret: the service does not start, naming them. Unknown to PingFederate: each enrolment's registration fails with the token endpoint's answer

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_SECRET
settings.description: PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID's secret, sent as client_secret_basic (RFC 6749 section 2.3.1); set this or PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_JWK, not both

when_wrong.detail: Wrong: each enrolment's registration fails with the token endpoint's 401

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_JWK
settings.description: PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_ID's private key as a JWK, for private_key_jwt: each token request carries an assertion it signs (ES256 for an EC key, PS256 for an RSA one, or the key's alg), with the token endpoint as its aud; set this or PF_AUTHORITY_CLIENT_SECRET, not both

when_wrong.detail: Not a JWK, or no private key: the service does not start, naming it. A key PingFederate does not hold for the client: each registration fails with the token endpoint's 401

settings.name: PF_AUTHORITY_TOKEN_ENDPOINT
settings.description: The authority's token endpoint, reached from here; <PF_AUTHORITY_URL>/as/token.oauth2 when unset

when_wrong.detail: Not an http or https URL: the service does not start, naming it. Wrong: each enrolment's registration fails, and the client's credentials go to whatever host it names
